purpose: Attempted explicit source migration for a complete native-alpha whole-body gait rebuild. The historical package is retained and may not be relabeled as a modern reviewed source set.
outcome: HOLD_SOURCE_ART: three current ImageGen E pair attempts were retained in quarantine. None may replace the legacy source art. The immediate repair is a runtime-package regeneration that removes the legacy mesh-warp renderer without changing source pixels.

legacyRuntimePackage.retention: Keep active until the modern replacement is complete and its source, cycle, runtime, visual, and app gates have passed.

migrationConstraints.background: native RGBA alpha 0..254; no chroma-key or local matte derivation
migrationConstraints.motion: six authored whole-body frames per direction: left contact, right swing, right passing, right contact, left swing, left passing
migrationConstraints.runtime: distance-driven phase using actual post-collision displacement; no mesh warp, split upper/lower body, or cadence-only repair
